summary: Hurts is out for the year and Smith and Wicks are out, so Dallas is a 4.5-point road favorite on a thin Eagles offense. Most likely to win: Dallas Cowboys ML (-218, about 66% fair).

extra_legs.note: Hurts is done for the season and the Eagles are missing Smith and Wicks, so a 17.7 ppg offense faces a defense that is bad but not Philly-proof; DK -218 is the best price.
My projection is 42.5 (DAL 24.0, PHI 18.5) against 44.5; DK already shaded to 43.5 and Under money is arriving, so the cushion is small but real.
Fair coin flip: Covers, SI and VSiN like the home dog, but the offense (14 points vs CAR) and Philly's 1-5 ATS mark argue against paying -110.
Dak averages 273 yards, cleared 276 in four of five games and faces a Philly defense allowing 254 passing yards; script risk is a lead that shifts him to the run.

totals_projection.math: DAL: avg(25.2 scored, 22.8 allowed PHI)=24.0, kept at 24.0 as a favorite protecting a lead; PHI: avg(17.7 scored, 26.5 allowed DAL)=22.1, cut to 18.5 for McKee, no Smith/Wicks and 14 points vs CAR. Total 42.5 vs FanDuel 44.5 (DK 43.5).
